explication: Autoware Universe is a large collection of packages extending autonomous-driving capabilities, rather than one executable application. Its product areas include control, perception, planning, localization, sensing, simulation, and system management. The visible control workflow accepts joystick input and runs a trajectory-follower node that selects lateral and longitudinal controllers; other shown components provide independent perception, planning, and operational capabilities. Edges are limited to relationships evidenced by the excerpts or SOURCE INDEX; unsampled subsystems are represented without speculative connections.
